title: Cookbook Menus
description: A collection of menu sets, each grouping related menus under a common title.

MenuItem.title: Menu Item
MenuItem.description: A single course in a menu: either a string naming the dish, or a choice object listing two or more alternatives.

choice.description: Two or more alternative dishes for this course.

Menu.title: Menu
Menu.description: A single menu with an ordered list of courses, an optional wine pairing list, and optional occasion metadata.

title.description: The title or label for this specific menu.

items.description: The courses of the menu in serving order.

wines.description: Suggested wine pairings for the menu.

metadata.description: Optional occasion details for historical or special menus.

date.description: The date on which the menu was served.

location.description: The venue or establishment where the menu was served.

occasion.description: The event or occasion the menu was prepared for.

MenuCollection.title: Menu Collection
MenuCollection.description: A titled group of related menus (e.g., 'Menus for Luncheons').

title.description: The heading for this collection of menus.
